paper.title: A complete formalization of Fermat's Last Theorem for regular primes in Lean
paper.shortTitle: A complete formalization of Fermat's Last Theorem for regular
paper.authors: Alex Best, Christopher Birkbeck, Riccardo Brasca et al.

thesis: We formalize a complete proof of the regular case of Fermat's Last Theorem in the Lean4 theorem prover.

nodes.body: How is the reported theorem converted into a machine-checkable proof?

nodes.title: Fix the formal system
nodes.body: Our formalization includes a proof of Kummer's lemma, that is the main obstruction to Fermat's Last Theorem for regular primes.

nodes.title: Machine-check the proof
nodes.body: The graph treats the study's reported formal proof procedure as the investigation that tests its central claim.

nodes.title: Primary reported result
nodes.body: Rather than following the modern proof of Kummer's lemma via class field theory, we prove it by using Hilbert's Theorems 90-94 in a way that is more amenable to formalization.

nodes.title: Published conclusion
nodes.body: We formalize a complete proof of the regular case of Fermat's Last Theorem in the Lean4 theorem prover.
